text.en: Believing Brewster's angle is a fixed universal angle (like 45°), rather than depending on the ratio of the two media's refractive indices — going from air into glass gives a different Brewster's angle than going from glass into air.
text.et: Uskumine, et Brewsteri nurk on kindel universaalne nurk (näiteks 45°), mitte see, et see sõltub kahe keskkonna murdumisnäitajate suhtest — õhust klaasi minnes on Brewsteri nurk erinev kui klaasist õhku minnes.
